name: MUHAMAD HENDRI FEBRIANSYAH
title: Senior Software Engineer (Frontend, Full Stack & Web3)

summaries.general: Results-driven Senior Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience architecting high-scale Web2 and Web3 systems. Demonstrated track record building real-time mission-critical dashboards for NTMC Korlantas Polri (< 500ms streaming latency), scaling native Android platforms to 1.5M+ active users (38.6% APK reduction, 99.42% crash-free rate), and developing autonomous Web3 AI agents. Deeply proficient in React 19, Next.js 15, TypeScript, Laravel 12, Kotlin, and Solidity, with a strong focus on type-safe clean architecture.
summaries.frontend: Senior Frontend Engineer with 6+ years of experience building high-performance, real-time web applications. Proven success leading the frontend architecture for the NTMC Traffic Command Center using React 19, React Router v7, Tailwind CSS v4, and Pusher WebSockets (< 500ms event latency). Specialized in modern TypeScript ecosystems, TanStack Query/Table, Next.js 15, and Web3 UI integration, committed to pixel-perfect performance and type-safe architecture.
summaries.android: Senior Android Engineer with 6+ years of experience engineering robust, high-scale mobile applications using Kotlin, Java, and Android Jetpack. Spearheaded native Android development for an education platform with 1.5M+ active users (4.42/5.00 Play Store rating), reducing APK size by 38.6% (69.5 MB to 42.7 MB) and maintaining 99.42%+ crash-free sessions. Certified Android Developer Expert (MADE) specialized in Clean Architecture, MVVM, Coroutines, and Room DB.
summaries.web3: Full Stack Web3 & AI Engineer with extensive experience building decentralized applications (dApps), Ethereum smart contracts (Solidity), and Telegram Mini Apps (TMA). Proven track record at Kipley Pte. Ltd. engineering high-concurrency Telegram AI agents with multi-chain crypto settlement (TON, USDT, Stars) and integrating Next.js 15 frontends with DeFi/NFT protocols via Wagmi and Ethers.js with zero-failure transaction reliability.

bullets: Architected and deployed the **NTMC Command Center Dashboard Utama**, an operational traffic & incident monitoring platform utilizing **React 19**, **React Router v7**, **TypeScript**, **Tailwind CSS v4**, and **shadcn/ui**.
Spearheaded real-time bidirectional streaming via **Pusher WebSockets**, achieving **< 500ms incident broadcast latency** and instant multi-screen telemetry synchronization.
Engineered high-performance server-side data tables with **TanStack Table v8** and server-state caching via **TanStack Query v5**, supporting complex multi-field filtering across large datasets.
Designed 100% type-safe form workflows using **React Hook Form** with strict **Zod** schema validation and interactive visualization charts via **Recharts**.

Delivered robust enterprise backends, virtual exhibition platforms (**Efosh**), tax e-Bupot systems, and **Petrokimia Gresik** insurance claim portals leveraging **Laravel 12/10**, **Livewire**, **AWS S3**, and **MySQL**.
Engineered and orchestrated high-throughput **REST & GraphQL APIs** across 5+ flagship dApps, boosting frontend response speeds by **30%** through optimized caching layers.
Architected seamless **Ethereum Smart Contract (Solidity)** integrations with **Next.js 15 (App Router, Turbopack)** frontends via **Wagmi v2** and **Ethers.js v6** for secure DeFi/NFT transactions.
Developed an autonomous **Telegram AI Assistant** supporting multi-chain settlement (**TON, USDT, Telegram Stars**) and fiat on-ramp integrations with **100% zero-failure transaction reliability**.
Championed Agile sprint execution, collaborating cross-functionally with UI/UX and product teams to deliver feature releases on schedule.
Spearheaded native **Android (Kotlin & Java)** development for a flagship EdTech platform serving **1,500,000+ active users** with a **4.42/5.00 Google Play Store rating**.
Architected a modular **Clean Architecture & MVVM** refactor using **Android Jetpack**, shrinking application size by **38.6%** (**69.5 MB to 42.7 MB**) and boosting runtime rendering performance.
Optimized core background sync and memory allocation to sustain a **99.42%+ crash-free session rate** across continuous 90-day production release cycles.

Maintained enterprise **Liferay OSGi web portal modules** (100+ micro-modules), integrating national **RIASEC psychometric testing**, **WebRTC live video counseling**, and automated payment gateways (**BCA, OVO**).

Architected scalable web backends for **Kemdikbudristek RI (EPAK Widyaprada)** national civil servant credit scoring, automotive e-commerce, and CRM platforms using **PHP Laravel**, **MySQL**, and **AWS S3**.
Engineered secure payment gateway integrations (**Midtrans Snap**, **Moota**) and Google APIs, guaranteeing **99.9% billing transaction accuracy** and automated reconciliation.
Developed companion native Android applications utilizing **Kotlin**, **Android Jetpack**, and **Firebase** for real-time data synchronization.
Configured CI/CD deployment pipelines on **Linux/SSH**, **cPanel**, and **Plesk**, ensuring high availability and zero-downtime production rollouts.
